## Checklist

- [ ] One topic per pull request, branched from `main`
- [ ] Tests added or updated (a bug fix has a test that fails without it)
- [ ] The checks in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md#set-up-and-run-the-tests) pass locally
- [ ] Docs and `CHANGELOG.md` updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] New API endpoints have an access rule in `permissions.py`
- [ ] **No secrets, real customer domains or real server addresses** in the diff, tests or docs
